name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 7 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-05-04, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.49 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
